sources.title: Israeli software giant NICE to lay off 500 employees worldwide, 5% of workforce
sources.description: As AI transforms customer service, the Israeli software giant is restructuring following its $1 billion acquisition of German startup Cognigy; its roughly 1,000 employees in Israel are expected to be largely spared, as quarterly earnings approach

sources.title: NiCE Boosts FY26 Adj. EPS Outlook; To Cut 5% Workforce - Update
sources.description: While reporting financial results for the third quarter on Wednesday, NiCE Ltd. (NICE) raised its adjusted earnings guidance for the full-year 2026, while reiterating annual adjusted revenue outlook.
